name: candles
purpose: Open, high, low, close, volume, quote volume and trade count per venue, instrument and time window, at one minute, five minutes, one hour and one day, windows half-open and in UTC.
limitations: Kraken only, as canonical-trades is. A window with no trade has no row, rather than a row carried from the last close. A candle is final only once every trade in its window has reached canonical-trades: a trade published late (a venue frame held and taken back) recomputes its candles on the next build, at every timeframe. A venue's later delivery of a trade (is_duplicate) is not counted. quote_volume rounds each price to 12 and each quantity to 10 fractional digits before multiplying, which loses nothing while the listing's pair_decimals and lot_decimals are at most those. The venues' terms of reuse are not yet recorded: the product stays owner-only until they are.
usage: Read market_analytics.candles.ohlcv_1m, ohlcv_5m, ohlcv_1h or ohlcv_1d, keyed by (venue, instrument_id, window_start); a window is [window_start, window_end) in UTC, so a day is a UTC day. A delayed_reader sees a candle once window_end is at least 20 minutes old.

outputs.purpose: One row per venue, instrument and one-day window holding at least one trade: its open, high, low, close, volume, quote volume and trade count over the window's trades, duplicates excluded, the window half-open [window_start, window_end) in UTC. The day is the UTC day, from 00:00:00 UTC to the next, whatever time zone a reader sets.

columns.name: venue
columns.description: The venue the trades happened on.

columns.name: instrument_id
columns.description: The security master's instrument the trades are of.

columns.name: window_start
columns.description: The window's first instant, inclusive, in UTC, at midnight.

columns.name: window_end
columns.description: The window's end, exclusive, in UTC: window_start plus 1 day. Every trade counted has trade_ts before it, so the delayed_reader's delay on it holds for every trade in the candle.

columns.name: open
columns.description: The first trade's price, first by trade_ts, ties broken by the venue row's key (kafka_partition, kafka_offset, trade_ordinal): the capture's order, as the archived candles broke ties by receive time and position in the frame.

columns.name: high
columns.description: The highest price.

columns.name: low
columns.description: The lowest price.

columns.name: close
columns.description: The last trade's price, in the order open uses.

columns.name: volume
columns.description: The sum of the trades' quantities, in the base asset, exact.

columns.name: quote_volume
columns.description: The sum of price times quantity, in the quote asset: each price rounded half up to 12 and each quantity to 10 fractional digits first, the sum to 18.

columns.name: trade_count
columns.description: The trades counted, each once (is_duplicate false).

columns.name: first_trade_at
columns.description: The earliest trade_ts counted.

columns.name: last_trade_at
columns.description: The latest trade_ts counted.

columns.name: through_load_seq
columns.description: The highest canonical-trades load_seq the build that wrote this row had read: the table's watermark is its highest value, and the next build recomputes the windows of the trades written past it.

roles.inWords: only rows whose window_end is at least 20 minutes old; through_load_seq read as null
